name: Tiny LLM training experiments in Rust/Candle

mentions.name: Tiny LLM training experiments in Rust/Candle
mentions.description: A hobby project that trains a tiny LLM from scratch using Rust and the Candle framework. It involves constant tweaking with results tracked in a spreadsheet, plus building a ~17 MB training corpus of LLM-generated stories, encyclopedia-style content, and JSON examples. The model can answer simple extractive questions (where the answer appears in the prompt) with up to 75% accuracy, and the goal is learning and fun rather than production use.
mentions.source_excerpt: Training a tiny LLM for fun using Rust/Candle - I constantly tweak stuff and keep track of results in a spreadsheet and work on generating a bigger corpus with LLMs. It's a project for fun, so I don't care about finding actual human generated text, I'd rather craft data in the format I want using LLMs
